title: test(i18n): objectView-config-keys-retired pins `SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT = 103` (and 229 total), so any legitimate key added to console.objectView reds it — pin the retired list only
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:ui` (i18n package).

**Measured:** `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts:298` `SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT = 103`, :325 `RETIRED + SURVIVING == 229`, :349 `enKeys toHaveLength(SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT)`; the comment above it logs 104 → 105 → 103 as keys were added and retired (objectui#13052, #13330, objectstack#25921). The guarantee the test exists for (objectui#4730: the retired config-panel vocabulary never comes back) needs only the retired list.

**Wanted:** keep `RETIRED_OBJECT_VIEW_KEYS` and the assertion that none of them is present in any pack; delete `SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT`, the 229 sum and the length pin (an anti-vacuity `enKeys.length > 0` may stay). **Acceptance:** adding a `console.objectView.*` key changes no test; retiring one still requires the list edit. **Size:** XS. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
